figurative_meaning_en: Sarcastically, a bride or wife who wears an excessively long veil
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এমন কলাবধূ যে বাইরে বের হলেই ঘোমটা টেনে নেয়।
গ্রামের কলাবধূরা এখনও পুরনো রীতি মেনে চলে।
example_sentences_in_english: She is such a banana bride that she pulls her veil even when stepping outside.
The village banana brides still follow the old customs.
history: Refers to traditional Bengali practice of ghomta (veil) among married women, symbolizing modesty, common in rural areas before modernization.
note: The idiom mocks excessive adherence to veiling customs.
